Bounded height review complete. **Selected candidate: `candidate_01`** (revision of seed; plan layout, partition topology, opening count, horizontal spans and connectivity untouched).

## What was done
Read all four elevations' vertical chains at zoom (ticks + drawn window pixels cross-checked), recorded 10 located claims, **confirmed the 5 already-correct scopes** against the seed via `confirm_claims` (status: confirmed_unchanged), then applied **claim-referenced corrections** in one `revise_bim` (application_0001, applied) and superseded the two obsolete assumption notes in the saved source.

## Corrections applied (evidence-backed discrepancies)
1. **All 8 F2 windows** (W2_N1/N2, W2_S1–S4, W2_E, W2_W): 3.8–5.6 → **4.0–5.8 m**. Every facade chain reads top-down 800/1800/1000 from the 6.6 m roofline: 800 is parapet-to-head; the sill is 1000 above the F2 floor. The seed had read 800 as the sill.
2. **W_S1** (small 1200-wide south window, plan span 3.45–4.62 m): 1.0–2.6 → **1.5–2.1 m**, per the South left chain 900/600/1500 (a separate chain from the wide-window chain).

## Exterior height coverage (final, from check_openings)
| Floor/Facade | Openings | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| F1 North | W_N1–N3 (1.0–2.6) | **all image-linked** (confirmed, claim_0001) |
| F1 South | W_S1 (1.5–2.1, applied), W_S2/S3 (1.0–2.6, confirmed), D_SOUTHW (0–2.1, pixel-linked) | **all image-linked** |
| F1 East | W_E1 (1.0–2.8) | **all image-linked** (confirmed, chain 200/1800/1000) |
| F1 West | D_ENTRY_W (0–2.1) | **image-linked** — but pixel-only: no labeled chain on West; drawn head ≈2.0–2.1 m, 2.1 retained within reading error (claim_0010 unresolved retained) |
| F2 North/South/East/West | all 8 windows (4.0–5.8) | **all image-linked** (applied, claims_0005–0008) |

**17 of 29 openings now have current image-linked heights; no exterior facade scope remains unchecked.**

## Explicitly out of scope / unchecked
- **Interior door heights (12)**: F1 D_NA/NB/NC/SA/SB/SC and F2 D_M1/M2/O1–O4 remain **unchecked assumptions at 2.1 m** (no elevation evidence; interior heights were declared out of scope). This is stated in the saved assumptions note.
- D_ENTRY_W's exact head (2.0 vs 2.1 m) is unresolved — retained at 2.1 within reading error, recorded in the claim and delivery.
- Prior plan-level unresolved items (1F/2F dimension-chain conflicts vs drawn walls, no staircase, West horizontal chain vs drawn door width, W_N3/W2_N2 drawn-vs-chain offsets) are unchanged and remain in the saved unresolved list.

## Limitations
Source geometry self-consistency passes; **drawing fidelity is not evaluated**, and coverage means an adopted, image-bound z observation — not certified drawing truth. Resulting source elevations (all four facades) were rendered and visually compared against the original chains; they match. Viewer: `candidate_01/viewer.html`.
